verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Sai running with a local or self-hosted model. The docs say only that Sai is "model-agnostic" and lets you choose the planning model, which does not establish that a local model can be used. BYOD (running Sai on your own Mac or Windows device) is about where the agent executes, not where inference happens, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit. The open-source framework claim likewise never mentions local model support.
